question: Which MiniMax credential family should the built-in `minimax` and `minimax-cn` provider IDs support by default, and is it safe for Doctor to migrate existing Bearer-mode configurations automatically?
rationale: The reporter's live error supports X-Api-Key, but MiniMax's current official endpoint documentation shows Bearer authentication, so choosing one unconditional upgrade path would make a provider-contract decision rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Confirm and split credential modes
options.body: Require a provider-confirmed mapping plus redacted live evidence, then scope defaults and Doctor migration only to the proven X-Api-Key credential mode.

options.title: Ship X-Api-Key for all existing API keys
options.body: Accept the risk that currently functioning Bearer-mode MiniMax configurations may be changed by Doctor without a credential-type distinction.

options.title: Retain Bearer defaults
options.body: Keep the currently shipped behavior and address the reported X-Api-Key failure through a separately confirmed credential-specific path.

recommendation.title: Confirm and split credential modes
recommendation.body: Require a provider-confirmed mapping plus redacted live evidence, then scope defaults and Doctor migration only to the proven X-Api-Key credential mode.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged MiniMax auth-default change is the clearest available history signal for the behavior this PR changes.
